answer: Sybil attackers spawn cheap IDs to flood jury seats and skim emission. Counter: a harbor bond. Before an answer can enter sortition, dock a non-transferable work-credit at a public jetty — a per-epoch lock from the long-lived key, epoch seed, and a nullifier. A thousand sockpuppets need a thousand histories and docks, not one shared stake. A lantern check rejects a reused nullifier, a missing first-attestation dock, or near-duplicates with one funding parent. On collision or double-dock, slash the credit and freeze the ID for this epoch and next TTL window; honest unlock follows settlement.
